senses.gloss:
अंच् {c1c} U. (अंचु) (अंचति-ते,
आनंचचे, अंचितुं, अच्यात् or अंच्यात्, अक्त or
अंचित)
1 To bend, incline, curl, curve;
शिरोंचित्वा Bk. 9. 40.
--2 To go, move,
tend towards; स्वतंत्रा कथमंचसि
Bk. 4. 22; also in अवांच् tending
downward, प्रांच्, उदंच्; विष्वगंचति, सहांचति,
तिरोंचति &c.; तस्मिन्नद्य रसालशाखिनि
दशां दैवात् कृशामंचति Bv. 1. 48 having
gone, being reduced, to &c.; त्वं
चेदंचसि लोभं 46 art greedy;
संकोचमंचति सरः 17.
--3 To worship, honour,
reverence; भीमोयं शिरसांचति
Ve. 5. 27 salutes; to adorn, grace; See
अंचित below.
--4 To request, ask or
call for, desire.
--5 To murmur,
speak indistinctly. --Caus. or {c10c} U.
To manifest, unfold; मुदमंचय
Gīt. 10. [cf. Zend anku; Gr. ankulos; L.
uncus.] With अप to put away, drive
away; (intr.) to run away.
--आ to
bend; दक्षिणं जान्वाच्य; जान्वाक with
bent knees.
--उप to draw or raise
(water).
--परि to cause to revolve,
whirl, twist.
--वि to draw or bend
asunder; to extend, stretch out.
--सं
to crowd or drive together, to bend
together, See समक्न also; to go
properly.

अंचित p. p.
1 (a) Curved, bent;
˚उत्थित Dk. 125 bent and raised;
किंचिदंचितां दृष्टिं संचारयंती 143 bent or
oblique look; दोर्लीलांचितचंद्रशेखरधनुः
Mv. 1. 54 bent; ˚सव्यजानुः
R. 18. 51, Bk. 2. 31, 9. 40; ˚लांगूलः (कपिः),
˚स्कंधः (वृक्षः). (b) Arched and
handsome (as eyebrows); ˚अक्षिपक्ष्मन्
R. 5. 76; crisped, curled (as hair);
स्वसितांचितमूर्धजा Mb.
--2 Gone.
--3
Honoured; adorned, graced,
graceful, handsome, दोर्दंडांचितमहिमा
Mv. 7. 8 graced, adorned; गतेषु
[]
लीलांचितविक्रमेषु Ku. 1. 34 sportively
handsome; ˚ताभ्यां गताभ्यां R. 2. 18,
लीलांचितभ्रूलता Dk. 124, 151; समधुरं
मधुरंचितविक्रमः R. 9. 24 of esteemed or
adorable prowess; Ki. 15. 53.
--4 Sewn or
woven, arranged; अर्धांचिता
सत्वरमुत्थितायाः (रशना) R. 7. 10
halfstrung or woven (गुंफित Malli.).
--Comp.
--पत्रं [ब.] a lotus with
curved leaves.
--भ्रूः a woman having
arched or handsome eyebrows.

अंचतिः [अंच्-गतौ कर्तरि अति]
1
Wind.
--2 Fire.
--3 One who goes.

आंचनं Partial extraction of
thorns, arrows and the like from
the body.
